name: Constre — dark industrial contractor

source.method: Computed styles measured in Chromium at 1440px (scripts/extract-template.mjs → measured.json); reference-1..6.jpg are the full page in order. Grey 'PHOTO' tiles are photo slots — keep their size and position, fill them with the lead's real photos.

character: No-nonsense industrial contractor. Charcoal #171717 bands alternating with pale grey #f5f6f8, one safety-orange accent, a sturdy narrow grotesk for headings (Yantramanav 700) with Archivo body, square corners, orange line-before eyebrows, cards with a 4px orange bottom rule and numbered orange chips. Reads as reliable, organised, on-site.
reuse: Use for construction / contractor / builder / renovation / handyman / roofing / concrete / paving / fencing / masonry / demolition / industrial-service leads that want a dark, rugged, organised look. Put the lead's brand colour in the orange 'accent' slot; keep charcoal + pale grey as the base.

display.note: Headings, nav (UPPERCASE 16/500), buttons, eyebrows. Hero is UPPERCASE 60/700.

scale.note: a 68×4px orange rule under it, then the button 40px below
business name set vertically, orange 1px OUTLINE only, low opacity, behind the hero text

color.notes: Rhythm alternates DARK (#171717) and PALE (#f5f6f8) bands with white in between. Orange is used for small, sharp things: eyebrow line, number chips, card bottom rules, buttons, the newsletter strip.

spacing.container: 1280px max content column with 32px side padding (20px under 768px) — the SAME column for top bar, header, every section and footer. (Template measured 1320px; standardised to 1280 so every mockup shares one grid.)
spacing.sectionPaddingY: 105px top / 90px bottom (why-choose 50/70, case study 108/200 to let the next section overlap)
spacing.headingStack: eyebrow (line + text) → 7px → 48px h2 → 20px → paragraph (max ~590px) → 55px → content. Headings are LEFT-aligned, never centred.
spacing.header: 52px charcoal top bar (email · address left; square social icon cells with 1px dividers right) + 101px charcoal header: logo, UPPERCASE nav, square orange hamburger/offcanvas button
spacing.hero: 800px, photo right half / dark overlay left, text left-aligned in the container

components.button: Square, 15px 33px (≈56–60px tall), Yantramanav 17px/500, with a ↗ arrow icon after the label. Orange default, charcoal alternate.
components.featureCards: On the charcoal band: 3 white cards, each an orange 50px number chip ('01') beside a small grey label + 20px bold title, a 2-line paragraph, and an underlined 'Read More ↗' link; 4px orange bottom rule.
components.aboutSplit: Blueprint-drawing texture background. 590×480 photo left overlapping onto the band edge; right: eyebrow, h2, paragraph, orange button, and a 269px square photo pinned to the bottom-right.
components.serviceCards: Pale band, white cards: 80px pale-grey icon square with an orange line icon, 22px title, one-line text, a 240×140 photo at the bottom, orange bottom rule; slider arrows as 50px white squares.
components.whyChoose: Full-width photo on the left half; right: eyebrow, h2, paragraph, then orange 120px square stat block(s) with a 48px number — only real numbers from FACTS.
components.caseStudies: Charcoal band, white heading, project photos with a white caption box (30px title) overlapping their bottom.
components.testimonial: Charcoal band, photo left, quote right in 18px light text, name 22px white, orange quote mark.
components.newsletter: Full-width orange strip, 24px padding, 34px white title + white input + charcoal SUBSCRIBE button (only if the lead actually runs a newsletter; otherwise use it as a phone/quote CTA strip).
components.footer: Charcoal with an image texture, 85px top padding, 4 columns (about, quick links, services, latest / contact), 24px/700 column titles, #212121 bottom bar.

blueprint.spec: 800px; left-aligned: orange-square eyebrow → 60px UPPERCASE 3-line headline → short orange rule → orange button with ↗; vertical outlined business-name watermark; photo on the right
#171717 band, eyebrow + white h2 left, 3 white numbered cards with orange bottom rules
blueprint-texture band, photo left + text right + small square photo
#f5f6f8 band, left heading + intro, 3 service cards with icon + photo
photo half + text half with orange stat squares
#171717 band, project photos with overlapping caption boxes
#f5f6f8 band, portrait cards (only with real team photos)

signatureMoves: Left-aligned headings with a 35px orange line before an uppercase eyebrow
Square corners everywhere; buttons carry a ↗ arrow
Cards with a 4px orange bottom rule and an orange number chip
Outlined vertical business-name watermark in the hero
Blueprint/technical-drawing texture behind the about section
